coordinateSystem: percent of source canvas, [x1,y1,x2,y2], origin top-left; visually estimated, test overlay required
firstFocus: large, smiling, direct-gaze face shot from a close high selfie angle
visualHook: a concrete five-item promise beside a first-person selfie; freehand words bracket the face

subject.role: single person with connected hands/selfie grip

upperEnvironment.role: blue-green door, window, plants and site context

lowerEnvironment.role: gray stone paving, texture and perspective

lowerAction.role: joined hands and filming grip, must retain physical connection

dominantAxis: top-center head through face, torso and joined hands toward lower center
supportingAxes: left two-tier lettering along the face edge
negativeSpace: 2-5% width gap between left text and face
2-3% width gap between right text and shoulder/hair
lower y75-100 reserved for action and ground
imageTextRelationship: two asymmetric text brackets around an uncropped expressive face; white handwritten main title and small cyan Latin note overlay site texture without a text panel
occlusion: no lettering across eyes, nose or mouth
person remains integrated in one photograph, no sticker outline
depthOrder: person, clothes and connected filming object

whiteHand.weight: light to medium monoline with natural variation

cyanLatin.fill: small cool accent with very narrow light edge

effects: real skin, hair and paving texture
minimal light edge on cyan lowercase word
no cutout, glow or hard shadow
locked: one large central direct-gaze face at high selfie angle
left quantity above small lowercase topic
two lettering brackets leave face unoccluded
connected lower filming action and site texture
adaptive: exact color values within area and lightness roles
optional: small real-world warm prop accent when present in source
